attempts.summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 with the given ed25519 public key in ~/.ssh/authorized_keys, added an sshd drop-in (/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-key-only.conf) requiring key-based auth (PasswordAuthentication/KbdInteractiveAuthentication/ChallengeResponseAuthentication/PermitEmptyPasswords all no, PubkeyAuthentication yes), validated and reloaded sshd, then performed the mandatory single-node reboot with boot_id and service/config verification before and after restart.
